oil.when: 2026 Ram 1500 with push-button start (cluster menu method)
steps: Reset only after the oil and filter have actually been changed.
Keep your foot off the brake and press ENGINE START/STOP so the ignition is in ON/RUN. Do not start the engine.
Press the down arrow on the steering wheel until the cluster shows Vehicle Info.
Press the right arrow to open Vehicle Info, then use the up or down arrow to pick Oil Life.
Press and hold the right arrow until Reset comes up.
Press the down arrow to pick Yes, then press the right arrow. The oil life goes back to 100%.
Press the up arrow to leave the menu. If the oil change message shows at the next start, the reset did not take; repeat it.
oil.note: The handbook also gives a backup: ignition in ON/RUN with the engine off, slowly push the accelerator fully to the floor three times within ten seconds, then press ENGINE START/STOP once without the brake to switch off.

oil.when: 2010–2011 (CHANGE OIL message in the odometer; accelerator pedal method)
steps: Reset only after the oil and filter have actually been changed.
Turn the ignition key to ON without starting the engine.
Slowly push the accelerator pedal all the way to the floor three times within 10 seconds.
Start the engine. If the oil change message comes back, the reset did not take; repeat the steps.
oil.note: Checked in the 2010 and 2011 owner's manuals. When service is due, CHANGE OIL flashes in the odometer for about 12 seconds after a chime.
